text:
Sam: Quick mini-acceptance run for SFO GPU pool starting now. Goal: smoke checks + network perf + simple inference. Tagging @maria @lee for infra and @devon for cost tags. Plan to handoff to oncall if green. /cc @infra-bot

Maria: On it. Did bootstrap script finish? Which image?

Lee: bootstrap finished @Sam. Nodes show Ready (8/8), driver v535, cudnn ok. nv_peer_mem loaded on 4 hosts.

Devon: Checklist I ran locally (short):
- node readiness
- kernel modules
- pod scheduling
- storage mount
- sample model run
- billing tags

Devon: Pasting quick commands I used:
```
kubectl get nodes -o wide
kubectl logs pod/gpu-smoke -c runner
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.total,utilization.gpu --format=csv
```

Lee: sample inference (gpt-small) 1 token latency ~12ms on cold start, ~3ms steady per token. Throughput sanity: 600 tps with batch size 8 in local run.

Priya: Network perf between SFO racks looks fine: iperf3 avg 9.1Gbps, p95 latency 0.12ms. No packet drops.

Sam: Any SLO gates we should check before handoff? I'm thinking: node readiness, driver version match, p95 latency <1ms intra-rack, cross-rack <2ms, billing tags present, per-GPU util <95% w/ 10% headroom.

Maria: Agree. Also ensure autoscaler annotations set, capacity reservations applied for dedicated pool, and firewall rules for control plane.

Lee: Added small smoke test result blob:
```
Smoke: PASS
NodesReady: 8
PodsSchedulable: 22
DiskMounts: OK
Iperf(p95): 0.12ms
ModelLatency(p95): 3.4ms
BillingTags: present
``` :white_check_mark:

infra-bot: Handoff checklist status changed to: ready_for_oncall by lee

Sam: Nice. Cost note — estimated incremental cost while burst enabled ~ $48/hr for the pool during the test window. @devon confirm?

Devon: Confirmed. Baseline + burst ~48/hr. Will add to ticket for finance tagging.

Priya: One minor note: saw 1 network flit error on host sfo-gpu-07, NIC reset cleared it. Not reproducible. Marking as monitor-only for now :eyes:

Sam: OK let's handoff. @oncall who's taking the shift? If no answer in 15m we auto-escalate to infra oncall.

Maria: I'll ping oncall and start runbook handoff doc update.

Lee: Uploading logs to the ticket: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INFRA-4123

Sam: Thanks team. Moving to READY -> handing to oncall. :wave:
